name: 深層迷宮
author: Unwritten Land Demo
notes: 迷宮探索（第一人稱走格子） pins camera:first_person + physics:grid_step + content:maze, so every scene plays on the dungeon_grid@1 kit.
類 Rogue adds content:procedural_runs + progression:run_based; rules.oui gets Generate("maze", 0, 0, 18).
A scene only fixes its two ends: the spawn tile (floor centre) and the Exit. The maze between them is generated from the run seed with a guaranteed route.
Floors are odd-sized so the carving grid stays aligned.
